The complete user command inventory is cron.start -> storage_write, cron.end -> storage_write, cron.list -> storage_read. All three use the shared path; there are zero off-path user cron commands and therefore no user-command exceptions. Internal scheduler methods are not additional user commands: tick dispatches due jobs, record_run records execution completion, set_next computes the next scheduled run, and cooperative stop ends a running worker; those runtime actions keep their existing domain transactions (ANC-053/054).

Every compile, session run, session dump/load and host-function dispatch requested by sc-cron is executed only by sc-monty. sc-cron only selects source/cache entries, converts JSON to Monty values and supplies cron-specific value adapters; it contains no interpreter compiler, session runner or host dispatcher of its own (ANC-041).
